He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?!
